basic_info.description: Rarely available condo in central, vibrant NOPA neighborhood near the Panhandle and Golden Gate Park. Exceptional architectural design with exposed concrete columns, soaring ceilings, and open concept layout. 1 bedroom plus den with 2 baths, 2 huge parking spots, tons of storage, fireplace, private terrace, in-unit laundry. Lots of southern-exposure light from big windows. Spacious living room features a cozy wood-burning fireplace, perfect for relaxation or entertaining. The updated kitchen has ample cabinetry and breakfast bar, The spacious bedroom includes a walk-in closet. Both the living room and bedroom have sliding doors that open to the terrace, perfect for morning coffee. Additional den/office and large storage area in the unit. Loft-like feel. Peaceful ambiance. Warm, inviting feeling throughout. Boutique, 13-unit building in what was formerly a taxi-cab garage in the 1920's. Beautiful flooring throughout and freshly painted. 2-car side by side parking (rare!), and additional dedicated storage in garage. Great neighborhood near park & transportation. Walk to coffee. Haight-Ashbury, Cole Valley, Laurel Village and Divisadero Street, the Koret Center and USF are all close by.
